import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { AircraftsService } from 'src/app/services/aircrafts.service'; import { AirlinesService } from 'src/app/services/airlines.service'; import { Aircrafts } from 'src/app/services/aircrafts.service'; import { UserHttpService } from 'src/app/user-http.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-airlines', templateUrl: './airlines.component.html', styleUrls: ['./airlines.component.css'] }) export class AirlinesComponent { updateData = { name: '', revenue: 0, aircrafts: [] as Aircrafts[] }; showSetup = false; mustChangePassword = false; constructor( private aircraftsService: AircraftsService, private airlinesService: AirlinesService, private us: UserHttpService ) {} // Salva compagnia + ogni nuovo aereo nel backend updateInfo() { // Chiama prima il servizio airline per aggiornare i dati generali this.airlinesService.updateAirline(this.updateData).subscribe({ next: () => { console.log("Dati compagnia aggiornati"); // Salva ogni aereo nel backend for (const aircraft of this.updateData.aircrafts) { this.addAircraftToBackend(aircraft); } }, error: err => { console.error("Errore aggiornamento compagnia", err); } }); } addAircraftToBackend(aircraft: Aircrafts) { this.aircraftsService.addAircraft(aircraft).subscribe({ next: () => { console.log(`Aereo ${aircraft._numAircraft} salvato correttamente`); }, error: err => { console.error("Errore salvataggio aereo:", err); } }); } // Altri metodi esistenti: addSeat, removeSeat, addAircraft, ecc. }
